# Pittsburgh Steelers Game Day Activities | Pittsburgh Steelers - Steelers.com

Ensure your phone is fully charged on gameday. Download your mobile ticket before arriving to Acrisure Stadium. Be sure to access your digital ticket(s) and save to your Apple or Google Wallet before you arrive at Acrisure Stadium.
Acrisure Stadium is a cashless venue. As a cashless venue, additional points of sale have been created, increasing convenience. Credit and debit cards are accepted, as well as Apple and Google Pay.

To provide a safer environment for the public and significantly expedite fan entry into Acrisure Stadium, the Pittsburgh Steelers will continue to enforce the NFL CLEAR BAG POLICY that limits the size and type of bags that may be brought into the stadium.

You will walk through new state-of-the-art screening machines at certain gates that do not require the removal of personal items (e.g. keys, cell phones, coats or bags). Simply walk through the system unimpeded.
No matter if you were waving your Terrible Towel at Acrisure Stadium or in the comfort of your own home, purchase your commemorative ticket to relive the moments of each game of the 2025 season!
Stop by the Steelers Pro Shop to purchase your Gameday Poster while supplies last! Each poster is uniquely designed to represent each of our home games for the season.

Celebrate with Steelers Nation on Art Rooney Avenue, home to the Steelers Experience, including photo opportunities, a 40 Yard Dash, entertainment, prize giveaways, the Hall of Honor Museum display, and more.
Location: Along the East Side of the stadium
Time: Open 3 hours prior to kickoff
Stop by the Official Tailgate Zone of the Pittsburgh Steelers, featuring live music, giant TVs to watch highlights and games, food and drink specials and contests.
Enjoy a performance from local cover band, Velveeta.
Time: Opens 4 hours prior to kickoff
Look out for photo ops, watch the live pregame show, Steelers Kickoff, explore the Steelers Pro Shop, with access to concessions all in the FedEx Great Hall.
Location: Enter through East side of Stadium
Time: Pregame Show - 30 minutes prior to kickoff
Located outside of Gate A, the new 44 X 25-yard Football Field provides a real football feel for all ages, housing the FedEx Air & Ground Zone with various football drills and activities.
Legend Q&A in the FedEx Great Hall

**Steelers Legend: Trai Essex**  
Hosted by Steelers Legend Arthur Moats  
Time: 11:30 - 12:00 pm
We're back in Pittsburgh for our **home opener**! We can't wait to see you at Acrisure Stadium for our first regular season home game.
**Bruce Dickinson** , the lead singer of Iron Maiden, will perform the national anthem.
Local high school football teams - the **Bethel Park Black Hawks** and the **Thomas Jefferson Jaguars** \- will face off during halftime.
Visit the Steelers tent located in the Ford Fan Zone on gamedays to grab food from various vendors, enjoy the views overlooking the city, and more.
Purchase your 50/50 raffle tickets during gameday to benefit the Art Rooney Scholarship Fund.
We recommend booking convenient and affordable parking in advance through JustPark, the nation's leading parking reservations app.

Gear up for gameday by visiting the Official Steelers Pro Shop located on Art Rooney Ave at Acrisure Stadium. The Steelers Pro Shop offers a variety of on-field sideline gear, jerseys, hats, terrible towels and more direct from the team!
